study: V99 R40 R30 tail-lift adaptive net hedge
objective: retain the strongest R30 defensive frontier and add a rare opposite-net BTC hedge only when chronologically trained R39 precursor thresholds show both high net exposure and market turbulence
threshold_source: R39 first-60%-chronological quantiles; thresholds are fixed before this candidate grid
grid_policy: 27 predeclared combinations = 3 fixed precursor presets x 3 extra hedge sizes x 3 cooldowns; validation horizons are not optimizer inputs
disclosure: Historical research only. Net exposure, BTC 3h absolute movement, cross-sectional breadth and volatility are known at close t and alter only the next requested target. R39 thresholds were estimated on the first 60% chronological sample before this 27-combination candidate grid. No real-order path is enabled. Any historical winner requires a frozen forward-paper period before promotion.
